MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 16
   C. 22
   D. 55

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 33

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

7. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 6
   C. 18
   D. 7

8. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

9. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

11. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 75
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 40

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
